001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.otlp;
002
003import java.util.Locale;
004
005/**
006 * OTLP/HTTP payload encoding, named as in {@code OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL}.
007 */
008public enum OtlpProtocol {
009
010        /**
011         * Binary protobuf, {@code application/x-protobuf} (the OTLP default).
012         */
013        HTTP_PROTOBUF("http/protobuf", "application/x-protobuf"),
014        /**
015         * JSON, {@code application/json}.
016         */
017        HTTP_JSON("http/json", "application/json");
018
019        private final String label;
020
021        private final String contentType;
022
023        OtlpProtocol(String label, String contentType) {
024                this.label = label;
025                this.contentType = contentType;
026        }
027
028        /**
029         * The protocol name as used by {@code OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL}.
030         * @return protocol name.
031         */
032        public String label() {
033                return label;
034        }
035
036        /**
037         * The HTTP content type of the request body.
038         * @return content type.
039         */
040        public String contentType() {
041                return contentType;
042        }
043
044        /**
045         * Parses {@code http/protobuf} or {@code http/json}, case insensitive.
046         * @param value protocol name.
047         * @return protocol.
048         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the value is not a supported protocol.
049         */
050        public static OtlpProtocol parse(String value) {
051                return switch (value.strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
052                        case "http/protobuf" -> HTTP_PROTOBUF;
053                        case "http/json" -> HTTP_JSON;
054                        case "grpc" -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
055                                        "OTLP protocol 'grpc' is not supported. Use http/protobuf or http/json.");
056                        default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
057                                        "Invalid OTLP protocol: '" + value + "'. Expected one of: http/protobuf, http/json.");
058                };
059        }
060
061}
